summary: Implemented the stubs in charsetgroupprober.py (reset, charset_name, language, feed, get_confidence), escprober.py (reset, charset_name, language, get_confidence, feed), utf8prober.py (reset, charset_name, language, feed, get_confidence) and universaldetector.py (reset, feed, close, plus the input_state, has_win_bytes and charset_probers properties that chardet/__init__.py uses); the data-table modules and metadata/__init__.py had no stubs. The last full-suite run gave 34 passed, 342 failed and 7 xfailed; the failures trace to sibling-owned files (multibyte base and Big5-style probers without charset_name/language, CodingStateMachine without a language property), and with those stubbed in-process my detector logic passed 108 of 110 files in the encodings I checked.
